interactables.name: Tibbet Quarrelspring
pages: Welcome to Cogskill! Shops are 1-hundreds down here, 2-hundreds upstairs. Food court's up top, round the overlook.
Lost property? Third drawer. Mostly single gloves, and a pigeon who has refused to be claimed since Sew.
A Goolax fellow asked me where their 'back office' was. I said, 'What back office?' He said, 'Exactly.' Then winked. Odd.
Lift's in Toggletec. Stairs at the west end, in Dullard's, and out by the arena ring.
Rents went up when Orichalcum Ventures bought us. Info desks too. I now rent this stool, by the week, from a company I have never met.
My cousins in Quone write about the 'Squat Squabble' like a cricket score. Thirty-eight years I've heard gnomes miss the old empire. None of us were there, dear.

0: Tryouts are Seluday, 9 Rest! Arena's straight down the east concourse. Follow the smell of fresh paint.
4: Selunemas decorations are up! Please don't climb the food-court tree. Yes, that includes D'fains.
6: Season's over! Lost-and-found is now 40% foam fingers.

brushoffs: The desk has told you everything, dear. The desk is tapped out.
Directions are free. Repeats cost a smile. Go on, smile.
Security! ...No, Nubb, sit down, I'm joking. Shoo, dear.

interactables.name: Officer Nubb Grindlecheek
pages: Mall security. No running, no brawling, unless you're on the team. Then go and brawl somewhere with insurance. That's handbook page twelve.
Keep your crystons in your front pockets. Gok'Gok pickpockets are very well organised. They have a union, and their dental's better than mine.
Saw some kid try to ride the fountain fish yesterday. Not on my watch. Not again. Last time I went in after him, and the fish bit ME.
There used to be three of us on this floor. The new owners cut it to one, and the one is me. I eat lunch at the desk now. Pudding included.

4: Three D'fains already today. I have to check every beard. It's in the handbook now, page forty. Two of the beards were real. I apologised to both.
5: Selunemas rush. If you see a D'fain running, it's either a pickpocket or a very late dad. Either way, I'm not fast enough.

interactables.name: Grub Ladlesworth
pages: Soot-kebabs! Smoked over a real factory chimney! The factory shut in Sew, but the chimney's still warm if you know where to stand. Two coppers!
Can't afford a unit inside. Not since the rent went up. Out here the only landlord is the weather.
Brawlers eat free on Seluday. Well. Brawlers eat at a discount. Well. Brawlers eat.
Six years I had a tiled stall by the fountain. My mum came every Thoughtsday and sat on the same stool. When I moved out here, she brought her own.

interactables.name: Pippa Lumenwhistle
pages: Hello! Have you considered an honest government? I know, it sounds wild out loud. I've got a pamphlet that makes it sound much more reasonable.
Excelsior Rigrod built his cryston farms from one seed crystal. Now he wants to build a council with nobody's hand in the till, including his own. He said that bit first.
We don't take bribes. We were offered a fruit basket last week and we sent it back. I still think about that basket. There was a pineapple.
I filed council minutes for six years. Somebody had always paid for the vote before it happened. You could tell by the handwriting getting neater.

3: We're up in the polls! I've been asked not to say 'way up'. I'm saying it with my eyebrows. Look at them go.
5: Selunemas pamphlets! Same promises, now with a snowflake border. Excelsior wanted to skip the border. I won that one.

brushoffs: I've given you every pamphlet. Even the draft one with the spelling mistake.
Honestly? I need to talk to somebody who hasn't said no yet.
Clean council, clean corridor. Please clear the corridor.

interactables.name: Skeezle Marrowpot
pages: BOSCO! You know him, you... know him! Button? They're free. Well, they were free. Now they're two coppers, because I'm paid in them.
Polls? Polls are a social construct. Bosco is a physical construct. A big one. I've stood next to him.
Bosco's coming to show his face this season! It's a very good face. Bit tired round the eyes, but you'd be tired too, being Bosco.
He shook my hand at the cryston-plant opening. Asked my name. I said 'Skeezle', and he said 'great to meet you, Steve'. Close enough. I've volunteered ever since.

2: New slogan: 'Bosco: He's Still Here!' I came up with it. They paid me in buttons. Gran wants the rent in coppers. I've explained buttons to her.
4: Bosco D'fain hats, free with any donation! The hats are also buttons. Everything is buttons now. I dream in buttons. Round ones.
6: Is the election over? No? Then BOSCO! ...Please take a button. I've got nine thousand, and Gran's started tiling the kitchen with them.

brushoffs: You've had a button. You've had TWO buttons. I counted.
Bosco appreciates your enthusiasm. From a slightly larger distance.
No more buttons! Shoo! For Bosco! ...Sorry. For Bosco, though.

pages: CRYSTONADE: 'Fizzes like a fresh cryston!' The machine eats your copper, thinks about it, and gives you a different flavour.
Flavours: Spark Berry, Lemon Volt, Original Factory. Original Factory has a little skull on it. It's the best seller.

interactables.name: Under the Bench
pages: Taped under the bench: a folded note. 'Dear whoever: the tiles round the fountain are slippery. Love, someone who knows.'
On the back, in different ink: 'They're not slippery. You're just clumsy, Dennick.'

hidden.hint: Something papery crinkles under the bench.

interactables.name: Sprocket Fizzlewick
pages: Mind the mop. Thirty years I've kept this place ticking: gears, pipes, vents, the lot. Started the week they put the fountain in. Gnorman still had his nose then.
Goolax techs've been in and out all season. Funny lot. Never use the front doors. Never sign my clipboard.
And ever since they came, ol' GEARFALL upstairs in Cryst-o-Games has gone glitchy. High-score table spits nonsense.
Not my machine, not my problem. But if I were a nosy sort... I'd look hard at those initials.

4: Mind the mop. And the tinsel. Thirty years, and tinsel's still the worst thing ever to happen to a vent.
Goolax techs've been in and out all season. Never use the front doors.
Since they came, ol' GEARFALL upstairs in Cryst-o-Games has gone glitchy. Look hard at those high-score initials.

interactables.name: Rivets
pages: *Whirr-click.* The mall's clockwork cat blinks its brass eyes at you, then pretends you aren't there. Very realistic.
Rivets rubs against your ankle. It's warm, and smells faintly of machine oil and fish.
Rivets is batting at a loose bolt. When you look, it stops and stares at the ceiling, as if something more important is up there.
A tag on Rivets's collar: 'PROPERTY OF COGSKILL MAINTENANCE. IF FOUND, DO NOT WIND.'

pages.text: Rivets stares up at the ceiling vents and gives one small, rusty mew. Missing someone?

interactables.name: Glimmer Voltaine
pages: Hi Acorndr! Live from Cogskill! Today's look is 'industrial but make it brunch.' Smash that acorn! ...Sorry. I talk like this now. I can't find the off switch.
She flicks her fingers and three little lights bob up round her face. 'Dancing lights. A ring light's forty gold. This was free, if you don't count school.'
My followers want MALL BRAWL content. Do you brawl? Can you brawl... near me? Just in frame. Left a bit. Now hit something.
I did hair in Gok'Gok for six years. Real clients, real gossip, real tips. Now I've got two thousand followers and none of them tip. Goolax pays me in stickers.

0: Pre-tryout hype reel! Everyone look intense! Okay, now intense but approachable! You. You're doing it. Don't move, don't blink, don't breathe.
1: Tryouts got SO many acorns. Someone hit a target so hard it's trending. Was it you? Lie to me.
2: Doing a 'beach day' look for the Sloopermarket week. The beach is a puddle by the Cryst-rail. I've put a shell in it. Content is content.
4: Selunemas haul video! I bought nothing, I'm just holding other people's bags. The bags are the trend. Please don't tell anyone they aren't mine.
6: Season recap reel is up. I cried at the end and I didn't film the crying. Weird, isn't it? First thing I've kept for myself in a year.

brushoffs: Love that for you. Anyway.
Babe, I'm LIVE. You're photobombing my brand, and my brand is having a day.
Security! ...I'm joking. Unless? No, joking. Move left. Further. Further. Perfect, now you're gone.

interactables.name: Stairs Up
pages: You climb to Level 2.

interactables.name: Dottie Pinwhistle
pages: My big brother says the Toggletec lift has a button that isn't a button. He says that's a SECRET. Now you know. Sorry, Bram.
I'm going to be a brawler when I'm big. I'll hit targets SO hard. Watch me hit this pillar. ...That one didn't count. I wasn't ready.
There's fish in the fountain. I named one Bolt. Then I couldn't tell which one, so now they're ALL Bolt. Even the orange one. ESPECIALLY the orange one.
Mum works upstairs on Seludays, so I have to stay where she can see me from the window. She waves every time. I wave back every time. It's our job.
brushoffs: I already told you my secret. I haven't got another one yet. I'm working on it.
You're not my brother. Why do you keep coming back? Are you lost? Mum says you have to say if you're lost.
MUM! The stranger's back! ...She says be polite. Hello. Goodbye. That was polite, now go.

interactables.name: Gnorman Memorial Fountain
pages: The Gnorman Memorial Fountain: a bronze gnome on a cog, pouring an endless jug into the pool. Coins glint at the bottom.

4: The bronze gnome on the fountain has been given a D'fain beard and a tiny sack. Very festive. Very wet.
5: Selunemas lights ring the fountain. The water glows green, red and gold. The fish look delighted.

interactables.name: Fountain Plaque
pages: IN MEMORY OF GNORMAN, WHO LOVED THIS MALL, AND FISH, IN THAT ORDER. MOSTLY.

interactables.name: Ornamental Fish
pages: Small orange fish dart about. A few are missing fin-tips. One stares at the surface with real suspicion.
Word round the mall is that someone has been fishing in here. With their mouth. The fish seem to have heard it too.
You count the fish. Then count again. There were more yesterday, according to a laminated sign: 'DO NOT EAT THE FISH.'

interactables.name: Glint in the Pool
pages: Among the coppers, one big brass coin. Stamped: MALL BRAWL · YEAR ONE. It's been down there fifteen years. You leave it for luck.

hidden.hint: Something big and brassy glints among the coppers.

interactables.name: Granny Hesk Copperbottom
pages: Forty years on this bench, dear. Four owners come and gone. This new lot sent me a letter about the BENCH. Rent, it said. I wrote back in pencil so they'd have to squint.
Someone's been fishing in the fountain. With their MOUTH. In my day we used a hook like decent folk, and never in front of Gnorman.
That Hex Topic's been here since the day the mall opened. Still black as a coal shovel. Lovely shop. I bought my funeral hat there. Not using it yet. It's nice to be ready.
Daranirn's got a new muscle. Big quiet scaly fellow. Very polite. Terrifying, but polite. I've started saying good morning to him first, to be safe.
GaGa Gardenia's girl does those dolphin stretches. I tried one on the bench. Can't feel my left ear, and the pigeons have stopped respecting me.

4: My grandson's dressing as D'fain this year. He's four foot nothing and the beard drags. His mum says he's too old for it. Nobody's too old for it, dear.

brushoffs: I've told you all I know, dear. My knees need the rest of the bench.
You're making the bench nervous again. It's had a hard year. It's paying rent now.
In my day we'd have been shooed with a broom. Consider yourself broomed. Off you go.

interactables.name: Fountain Statue
pages: The little bronze gnome's jug gurgles... and the statue's eyes swivel to look straight at you. Then back. Did that happen?

interactables.name: Vimsy Starbuckle
pages: Box office! Tonight: 'BRASS & BEYOND: THE BARD AUTOMATONS IN CONCERT'. Bard automatons on crystal projection. Very shiny. Very... precise.
It's a compilation. Machines that write AND play their own music. You can hear a little tinny ring on every note. Folk call it 'the clank'.
Matinees half price. Evening shows full price. Opinions free, but please keep them to yourself. Especially about the clank.
Xilliforth Theatre's been here since before the arena. We've seen everything. Including a musical about the arena.
I started here at fourteen, selling sweets from a tray. Now Orichalcum wants four shows a day. Three casts have quit since Reap. The crystal hasn't.

3: Box office! 'Opera for Brawlers', live! Actual people singing! I nearly cried at the dress rehearsal. Bring a helmet.
Projections are cheaper, but you can't throw roses at a projection. Well. You can. They go through.
4: 'Deep Strait' this week: crystal projection of the harbour floor. The crab gets a round of applause every night.
Selunemas pageant! 'D'fain and the Silver Sack.' Auditions for the back half of the reindeer-gear are open.
5: Pageant's sold out. I can sell you a ticket for the coat rack. It has a decent view.
6: 'Moons Over Toggleton': a projection of the Selunemas sky. Lie on the floor, look up. Snoring is permitted; one old gentleman has booked two seats for it.

brushoffs: Box office is closed to repeat questions. Open to ticket sales, which I notice you're not.
You've been here so often I could rent you a seat in the lobby. Orichalcum would want a cut.
Usher! Escort this patron to... anywhere. Lovely. Thank you.

interactables.name: Brannoc Velvetrope
pages: Ticket? No? Then you may stand there looking theatrical. Plenty do. Some seasons the lobby has had better performances than the stage.
The board stage left has been loose since the Klerp musical. The mayor tap-danced on it opening night. I won't let them nail down the only thing he left us.
Please do not applaud the fire exits. They know they're good.

pages.text: Projection show this week. I seat people, then watch light play a trumpet. The light never bows at the end, so I stand at the back and bow for it.

pages: Fourteen players in the company when I started. Now it's a crystal and a lad with a polishing cloth. They say the machines 'free us up'. I've never felt so free.

interactables.name: Loose Stage Board
pages: Stage left, a board lifts. Underneath: a dusty playbill. 'MAYOR KLERP: THE MUSICAL. Featuring the hit song "Cog Me Maybe."'
Someone has written 'NEVER AGAIN' across it in grease pencil, and signed it with forty different names.

hidden.hint: Stage left, one board sits a finger's width proud.

interactables.name: Gale-O-Matic 9000
pages: The Gale-O-Matic 9000 hand dryer roars to life. Your hands are dry. So are your eyebrows. So is your sense of humour.

interactables.name: Ferris Quickspanner
pages: Welcome to Toggletec! Crystons, coils, crystec, all certified! Ask me about our extended warranty. Please. I'm on commission, and it's been nine days.
That lift? Staff and shoppers. Mind the button panel, it's older than me. Some of the labels are... creative.
New this season: the Acorndr Pocket-Pane. Same as last season's, but it's lime green.
I started in the warranty cupboard, reading claims. 'Coil sang at high moon, frightened the dog.' Since the moon moved, I get three of those a week.

4: Selunemas special! Buy two crystons, get a third cryston-shaped ornament. It is not a cryston. A gentleman tried to charge one. The ornament did not survive.

interactables.name: Rizzik Ohmfang
pages: This one's 2% brighter, that one's 3% cheaper, and the gnome on the door thinks I'm stealing. I have receipts from the last six times I didn't.
My cousin swears Toggletec's lift has a button you're not meant to press. I pressed all of 'em. Got nowhere.
Don't buy the lime-green Pocket-Pane. Unless you're on the team. Then you HAVE to.
I test coils at the cryston farm. I listen for the hum all day, then I come here on my lunch and listen to more hum. My wife calls it a cry for help.

interactables.name: Tock Hinderwheel
pages: Clockpunk & Gizmo's! Wind-up toys, gizmos, gadgets and things that go 'boing'. The boingers are on sale. The whirrers are open to negotiation.
Best seller's the Mini-Brawler. Wind it up and it punches the nearest shin. Ages eight to eighty. I designed the shin-finding. Took me a whole winter.
Don't touch the gear on the back wall. It's not for sale. It's not even ours. It's... the mall's, I think. It was there before the shelves were.
He cups a broken tin frog and murmurs. The cracked spring knits shut. 'Mending. My mother taught me. Children cry less if you do it where they can see.'

1: Lime-green Mini-Brawlers are sold out! Tryouts did wonders. Restock next week, if the spring man in Gok'Gok answers his post.
4: Selunemas rush! Wind-up D'fains! They walk in a circle and drop a tiny sack. Children love it. Parents have started hiding the keys.

stock.name: Wind-Up D'fain
stock.desc: Walks in a circle, drops a tiny sack.

stock.name: Boinger
stock.desc: Goes 'boing' every time. Tock asked the spring maker in Gok'Gok for four springs and got forty, hence the sale.

interactables.name: Toy Shelf
pages: Wind-up beetles, a tin airship, and a box of 'Bosco Bobbleheads (Reduced!!)'. The second '!' was added by hand.

interactables.name: Brass Gear in the Wall
pages: A brass gear juts from the wall, worn smooth by thumbs. You turn it. *Clunk.* Somewhere nearby, the fountain gurgles oddly.

hidden.hint: One gear in the back wall is worn shiny by thumbs.

interactables.name: Mabsy Tumblecrock
pages: This was the Youngling Distraction Point for six years. Now it's the Land of Dreams Consulting Consortium, and I've come back as a client. The carpet remembers me.
My problem? The youngling union. Still active. Still demanding dental. If that's not an adventurer-sized problem, I don't know what is.
The flyer says the only price is a bad case of consecutive nightmares. I ran a ball pit for six years. I fear nothing.
We closed when the rent went up. Forty-one regulars. One of them never left the pit. I've stopped asking him to go home and started asking him to eat.

1: The younglings invented 'Mall Brawl' before we moved out. It's tag, but louder. I still have four confiscated foam swords. They'll get them back at thirty.

interactables.name: Leftover Ball Pit
pages: The Youngling Distraction Point left its ball pit behind. In it: one shoe, two dead crystons, a Mini-Brawler figure, and a youngling named Ozzle.

interactables.name: Ozzle Fenderbit
pages: The ball place moved out. The ball pit didn't. Neither did I. I live in the balls now. Don't tell my dad.
I'm a BRAWLER. I hit a ball so hard it went in the fountain. Ten points to Ozzle. Minus two for the fountain, the lady said.
There's a cat made of metal that comes in at night. It likes me. Its name is Rivets. I named it Steve. It doesn't come to either.
My dad does double shifts. He says when he's home we'll go to the arena. He's home Thoughtsdays but he sleeps all of it. I save him a ball.

interactables.name: LoDCC Flyer
pages: LAND OF DREAMS CONSULTING CONSORTIUM · Got a problem better suited to adventurers? Stop by unit 102. We source the quest. We complete the quest.
Price: one bad case of consecutive nightmares. The flyer is faded but still oddly vivid, and printed on alarmingly thick paper.

interactables.name: Hilda Brassmantle
pages: Dullard's: a department store for every department, including ones you didn't know you had. I've worked eleven of them. Kettles was the happiest.
Coats, kettles, crowbars, cravats. Second floor for homewares and the good socks. The good socks are behind the bad socks, on purpose.
Our mannequins are all perfectly ordinary. Please stop asking about the one by the stairs.
Nineteen years here. Mam ran a pit canteen in Beggle and said I'd end up underground. I'm on the ground floor. She says that's close enough to count.

4: Selunemas jumpers! Every one has a cog on it. It's in the new lease, apparently. I've read the lease. I'm the only one who has.

stock.name: Healer's Kit
stock.desc: Ten uses. Stabilise a creature without a Medicine check. Aisle three, left of the plasters, right of the other plasters.

stock.name: Rope, Hempen (50 feet)
stock.desc: Fifty feet. Aisle six since the takeover moved it from nine. Hilda measured a coil once: fifty-one feet. She told nobody.

stock.name: Crowbar
stock.desc: Advantage when leverage helps. Checked twice at the till since the takeover, like everything else in the shop.

stock.name: Bedroll
stock.desc: For napping on the bed display, legally.

stock.name: Tinderbox
stock.desc: Light a fire in an action. Hilda's mam lit a pit-canteen stove in Beggle with one of these every morning for thirty years.

stock.name: Rations (1 day)
stock.desc: Biscuits that will outlive us all.

stock.name: Copper Kettle
stock.desc: Snikkit's second choice, as Snikkit has told the whole department. Hilda keeps one at the back, just in case.

stock.name: Cog-Pattern Socks
stock.desc: The good socks. On the end.

interactables.name: Mannequin
pages: A mannequin in a tweed waistcoat. As you turn away, you could swear it winked. You turn back. It is very still. Too still.

interactables.name: Dullard's Stairs
pages: You head up Dullard's stairs to Level 2.

interactables.name: Snikkit
pages: Snikkit is buying a kettle. Snikkit has been buying this kettle for an hour. It is a big decision.
Folk think goo just likes shiny things because we can see ourselves in them. Snikkit likes GOOD things. This kettle is good. And shiny.
Snikkit heard the new owners will check every receipt now. Snikkit keeps every receipt. Snikkit is ready.
Snikkit used to live in a drain under the fish market. It was warm, but nothing in it was GOOD. Snikkit is catching up, one kettle at a time.

interactables.name: Pell Stitchgrin
pages: Welcome to Chasm, Textile Strip. 'Mind the Chasm' is the owner's slogan. I've said it eleven thousand times. I know because I count.
Basics in forty shades of grey-brown: Smog, Soot, Rust, Rusty Soot. I named all forty. The owner cut 'Cheerful', and for once he was right.
I priced every pair of jeans in here. The owner signed it without reading it, then told a customer goblins are 'so good with fabric'. I'm good with margins.
Goblins get about sixty years. Gnomes get four hundred. So when the owner says he'll 'revisit my raise in a decade', you can do the maths. I did.

2: Beachwear week. It's the same grey-brown in a shorter leg at the same price, and I'm the only one in this store who finds that interesting.
4: Selunemas line: grey-brown with a red stripe. I fought for that stripe for two months. Look at it. Look at my stripe.

stock.name: Common Clothes ('Rusty Soot')
stock.desc: Grey-brown. Outsold every other colour 41 to 3 this quarter. The 3 were returns.

stock.name: Traveler's Clothes ('Smog')
stock.desc: Hard-wearing, wind-proof, gloom-proof.

stock.name: Fine Clothes ('Soot, Formal')
stock.desc: The fanciest grey-brown in Gok'Gok. Same dye as 'Rusty Soot', thirty times the price, and a much better hanger.

stock.name: 'Rust' Hoodie
stock.desc: Supervisors call it camouflage. Take the compliment.

stock.name: Chasm Jeans
stock.desc: Pell priced every pair after the rent went up. The owner signed it unread, then took the credit at the staff meeting.

stock.name: Shirt Labelled With an Emotion
stock.desc: Pick a feeling. They're all the same shirt.

stock.name: Beachwear (grey-brown, shorter)
stock.desc: Grey-brown, two inches shorter. Sloopermarket week special. Pell sketched a blue version on a receipt and filed it.

stock.name: Selunemas Jumper (red stripe)
stock.desc: Grey-brown with one red stripe, the only colour the owner approved this year. Pell argued for two stripes and lost.

interactables.name: Chasm Rack
pages: CHASM · 'Bridge the gap in your wardrobe.' A rack of identical shirts, each labelled with a different emotion.

interactables.name: Orrin Buttonwhistle
pages: I need a shirt that says 'I'm not a factory worker' but also 'I could be, if needed'. Chasm gets me. The clerk has measured me four times and written nothing down.
Did you see the fountain? Someone was fishing in it. Face first. I'm not judging. I'm a little bit judging, but quietly, like a gentleman.
There's a riveter on the cryston floor who eats lunch on my bench. I work upstairs, in accounts. I'm trying to dress like I've ever lifted anything.

interactables.name: Gunnra Flintcask
pages: Ammo. Bolts, bullets, sling-stones, cannon charges. Only homologated stuff for the brawl, mind. Goolax checks, and Goolax counts slower than I do.
Small shop, big bangs. Don't touch the red crates. Don't touch the blue crates. Just stand there, nice and still, and point at what you want.
Buy a box of bolts, get a free earplug. One. They come in ones.
Nineteen years blasting quarry in Beggle. That's why I talk loud. Left ear's a souvenir. I sell earplugs now so you don't have to collect one.

1: Sold more practice bolts this week than all of last year. Tryouts! I love a tryout. Folk come in nervous and leave with a receipt.

stock.name: Arrows (20)
stock.desc: Twenty to a bundle, counted out loud at the till. Stamped fletching. Match-legal.

stock.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
stock.desc: Waxed for sandy arenas. Match-legal. Gunnra's count of the big crate stands at 640 of 912.

stock.name: Sling Bullets (20)
stock.desc: Twenty lead bullets, cast in Beggle by the quarry crew Gunnra used to blast with. They still send her a card at Selunemas.

stock.name: Light Crossbow
stock.desc: Stamped. Comes with one free earplug.

stock.name: Shortbow
stock.desc: Stamped. Goolax charges the stamp to Gunnra, and Gunnra charges it to you.

stock.name: Longbow
stock.desc: Stamped. Taller than Gunnra, which she'll tell you before you can.

stock.name: Quiver
stock.desc: Holds 20 arrows. Gunnra will fill it for you and count every one out loud, whether or not you're listening.

stock.name: Earplug
stock.desc: They come in ones.

interactables.name: Sergeant Dask Ironwhit
pages: Practice Range! Ten coppers a lane. Rules: point it downrange, not at me, and not at my lunch. My lunch has been shot twice this month.
Tryouts are about hitting targets. Zippy ones, heavy ones, normal ones. Practise here and save yourself the embarrassment of practising out there.
Best score this season? A tie between a dwarf with a crossbow and a youngling with a rock. I gave them both a sticker. The youngling ate his.
Twenty years I drilled caravan guards on the Glister road. Not one said thank you. Then one wrote from his retirement. I keep the letter in my hat.

0: Tryouts are about TARGETS. Zippy ones, heavy ones, standard ones. Lane's open. Go on. Show me what your hands do when you're nervous.
1: Tryouts are done, and I want my targets back. Someone took one home as a trophy. I'm not angry. I'm counting.
4: Target came back in brown paper with a note: 'sorry, it was for my mum'. I wrote back. Told her son to fix his stance. She can keep the target.

interactables.name: Practice Target
pages: A painted target. The bullseye is pristine. Everything around it is shredded.

0: A painted target with a Goolax logo. Freshly painted. It looks nervous.
1: A target with a hole clean through the middle, and a note: 'TRYOUTS — KEEP AS SOUVENIR?' ('NO' — Mgmt)

interactables.name: Zibba Snapcog
pages: Shimoto Motors! Clockwork striders, steam-mules, the new Shimoto Scuttle! Zero to Gok'Gok in under an hour!
Financing available! Low interest! Well. Interest! There is interest!
That one's a demo. Please stop sitting on it. Okay, you can sit on it. Make vroom noises if you must.
I sold fish off a cart in Gok'Gok Harbor from when I was nine. Fish don't need financing. Fish need ice. I miss how simple fish were.

3: Ride to Panto in style! ...You can't, it's very far. But you could ride to the Cryst-rail in style!
6: I SOLD ONE! A Scuttle, Executive Brass! To my mum. She paid full price and made me carry it home.

interactables.name: Shimoto Scuttle
pages: A six-legged clockwork strider, buffed to a mirror shine. The price tag has more digits than legs.

interactables.name: Wenna Haybright
pages: Ride or Die! Living mounts only. Beetles, lizards, a goat with opinions. No refunds, but lots of love, and every one of them is mucked out by me.
Mind Lord Clicks. He's a giant beetle and he's very proud. Tell him he's handsome and he'll let you pass. Tell him twice and he'll follow you home.
Shimoto next door says clockwork's the future. Clockwork never nuzzled anyone. Clockwork never knew you'd had a bad day before you did.
Folk here call it the Squat Squabble. Back home it's the war. My brother's still on the farm, hiding oats from Heliofax's lot. I send him beetle pictures.

interactables.name: Lord Clicks
pages: A giant iridescent beetle in a stall. A brass plate: LORD CLICKS. He clicks at you. You feel you have been judged and found adequate.

interactables.name: Goo to Go Express
pages: A vending machine with a nozzle. 'GOO TO GO EXPRESS — Slurp responsibly.' Today's flavour: Grey.

4: GOO TO GO EXPRESS · Selunemas flavour: Pine-and-Gravy. A sticker reads 'Sorry.'

interactables.name: Arena Sign
pages: THIS WAY ➜ MAYOR KLERP MEMORIAL ARENA · Home of COGSKILL's MALL BRAWL team · Goolax: for whatever ails you.

interactables.name: Shellby Mucklow
pages: Oh, hello. I'm visiting. I arrived... this morning? Last week? The concourse is very long when you're a snail, and very short when you're everyone else.
I've heard the arena's lovely. I'll be there by Seluday. I haven't decided which Seluday. I like to leave room for surprises.
The mall's very shiny. I keep seeing myself in the floor. Hello, me. We've been travelling together ninety years and he still waves first.
I wound the tide clock at the harbour office for sixty years. Then the moon moved and the tides stopped listening to it. I took that as a sign to see the world.

interactables.name: Wexley Tinbuckle
pages: I did NOT take the ferry to Banañon Town on my day off. I did NOT sneak into Galleria Overlook. ...But if I had? I'd have stories. Hypothetical ones.
The whole mall's shaped like a giant mushroom, up on a rock spire over the sea. Purple stone. Stairs everywhere. My calves have filed a complaint.
Fae EVERYWHERE. Little glowing ones. One took my sandwich and left an acorn. I've got it in a pot. If a tree grows in my flat, that's evidence, so I'm not watering it.
Don't tell my boss. The ferry back ran late, the tides have gone odd since the moon moved, and I clocked in at ten past. He thinks I overslept. I let him.

interactables.name: Brother Ambrel Cogsong
pages: Believe U-ME! Faith supplies for every faith. Candles, icons, prayer-gears. Selune on the left, Melune on the right, and a little shelf at the back for folk who aren't sure yet.
Our bestseller is the Universal Prayer Wheel. Spin it once, it covers everything. Spin it twice, it's showing off.
Well, since the moon moved, the Melune shelf empties twice as fast. Folk want to stay on good terms with whatever's doing the moving. I can't fault them for that.
He breathes on a wick and the candle lights itself. 'Blessings are free. Blessed items are not. Thirty years I kept a temple's books; theology is the easy column.'

4: Selunemas is coming! D'fain sits at Selune's side and brings the gifts. We stock both sides of the story: silver sacks for the good, coal for the honest.
5: Selunemas candles are nearly gone. The moon-shaped ones went first; the D'fain ones melt at the knees. I've put three aside for a widow who comes in on Seluday.

stock.name: Holy Symbol: Amulet
stock.desc: Selune on the left, Melune on the right. Since the moon moved, people keep asking which way up to wear it.

stock.name: Holy Symbol: Emblem
stock.desc: Sew it on your brawl kit. Brother Ambrel stocks forty-odd faiths and will stitch any of them on while you wait.

stock.name: Holy Water (flask)
stock.desc: Blessed this morning. Brother Ambrel blessed the till too.

stock.name: Luck Candle
stock.desc: Selune for luck: light it, then blow on your hand. Both teams bought a box before tryouts. Ambrel prayed for nobody's teeth.

stock.name: Universal Prayer Wheel
stock.desc: Spin once, it covers everything. Spin twice, it's showing off.

stock.name: Moon-Shaped Candle
stock.desc: 'Well, the moon ones go first at Selunemas.' He has put the last box behind the counter for someone.

interactables.name: Mixa Reagentwhit
pages: 'Gents! Reagents! Bat guano, powdered cryston, eye of newt (ethically sourced newt). Everything a caster needs.
Why 'Gents? The sign maker charged by the letter. We ran out of money at the apostrophe.
Pearls, sulphur, a pinch of starlight. That last one's just glitter. Don't tell the wizards.
I learned every component on these shelves by sweeping it up: two years cleaning floors at a wizard college. Never taught me a spell. I know what each one costs to cast.

stock.name: Component Pouch
stock.desc: Everything a caster needs, ethically sourced newt included.

stock.name: Orb (arcane focus)
stock.desc: Polished cryston glass. Mixa swept up the shards of eleven of these at the wizard college before she ever sold one.

stock.name: Wand (arcane focus)
stock.desc: Plain, reliable, slightly sulphurous.

stock.name: Sprig of Mistletoe (druidic focus)
stock.desc: Picked Thoughtsday. Druids sniff it, wizards haggle over it, and Mixa wins both arguments.

stock.name: Bat Guano (pinch)
stock.desc: A fireball component. Mixa's tasting notes, unrequested: cave, regret, a finish of bat.

stock.name: Pinch of Starlight
stock.desc: It's glitter. Don't tell the wizards.

6: Saved enough for one more letter on the sign. It reads 'R'Gents' now. Half the street thinks we're a pirate shop. Takings are up a third.

interactables.name: Morwick Gloam
pages: Mort n' More: the dark arts, the cosy kind. Today's special is mildly cursed teaspoons. Your tea is always slightly too hot. Lovely gift for someone you dislike.
Twenty-two years I filed death notices for the Toggleton registry. Very tidy work. I opened this so people could hold a skull and have a cup of tea about it.
The skulls are resin, apart from Gerald by the till. Gerald is not for sale. He was a regular here. He asked to stay on.
He breathes on the black candle. It goes out, then seems to think better of it and relights. 'It does that for me now. Took eleven years. Candles are shy.'

4: Selunemas stock: haunted baubles. They whisper carols, off-key, on purpose. Hang one near a relative who sings and let them sort it out between them.

stock.name: Mildly Cursed Teaspoon
stock.desc: Your tea is always slightly too hot. The last owner returned it after forty years, still blowing on every cup.

stock.name: Resin Skull
stock.desc: Resin, cast from Gerald, who sits on the shelf behind the till and finished a long while ago. Gerald is not for sale.

stock.name: Black Candle
stock.desc: Burns all evening. Morwick lit the first one the night he left the death registry, and he has never once missed the place.

stock.name: Spellbook (blank)
stock.desc: Black covers, cream pages, faint smell of incense.

stock.name: Ink (1 ounce bottle)
stock.desc: The registry's own black, the kind kept for writing in the finished. Morwick still knows the supplier.

stock.name: Ink Pen
stock.desc: Nib like a raven's beak.

stock.name: Wand (arcane focus)
stock.desc: Ebony, with a little skull on the end.

stock.name: Haunted Bauble
stock.desc: Whispers carols, off-key, on purpose.

interactables.name: Bolgrim Edgeworth
pages: Soardenbort. Melee supplies: swords, axes, hammers, and a mace I call 'Mister Polite'. Folk see him and start apologising for things they haven't done yet.
Homologated only for the brawl. Goolax stamps every blade on the handle and charges me a silver a stamp. Don't lick it. The ink's fresh, and so's the invoice.
Tryout lot came in here. One fella bought a shovel. Not a weapon, I said. He looked at me for a long while. I sold him the shovel.
Forty years I made pit-picks under Glister. Lungs gave out before the hammer arm did. Up here the air's better and the customers are worse.

0: Tryouts on Seluday! Get your blades checked and stamped. Goolax won't let you in with an un-homologated butter knife, and I'll have my silver either way.
6: Sold Mister Polite. Old lady, buying for her grandson. She said thank you to the mace before she said it to me. He'll be all right with her.

stock.name: Longsword
stock.desc: Every edge honest. Goolax stamp on the handle.

stock.name: Greataxe
stock.desc: Big, heavy, stamped. Don't lick the stamp.

stock.name: Warhammer
stock.desc: Bolgrim's favourite. After the shovels.

stock.name: Battleaxe
stock.desc: Versatile and stamped. Bolgrim calls her Agnes. Forty years making pit-picks under Glister and Agnes is the first thing he's named.

stock.name: Shortsword
stock.desc: Finesse, light, stamped.

stock.name: Greatsword
stock.desc: Two hands, one stamp.

stock.name: Mace
stock.desc: Not Mister Polite. Mister Polite is not for sale.

stock.name: Spear
stock.desc: Stamped. Goolax charges Bolgrim a silver per stamp, which is a tenth of this spear.

stock.name: Shield
stock.desc: +2 AC. Goolax-stamped rim. Hammered from a Glister mine-cart door, Bolgrim says, and dented the once.

stock.name: Shovel
stock.desc: Not a weapon, Bolgrim says. He'll sell it to you anyway.

interactables.name: Daranirn
pages: Daranirn's Exotic Wonders. Look all you like. Touch only what you are buying. Lick nothing; the last gentleman who did is still tasting colours.
Everything here came a long way. Paperwork's in order. Don't ask me which order.
My muscle's about somewhere. Big. Quiet. You'll know him when he's looming.
Twenty years I sailed cargo on the Strait. Then the moon moved and the tides stopped keeping appointments. Now my wonders arrive late, and I am still on land.

stock.name: Bone Shield
stock.desc: Lacquered bone that crossed the Strait twice before the tides went wrong. +2 AC, like any shield. Goolax-stamped on the rim.

stock.name: Bone-Handled Handaxe
stock.desc: A handaxe with a carved bone grip. Light, thrown. Stamped.

stock.name: Bone Dagger
stock.desc: Sharper than it looks. Finesse, light, thrown. Stamped.

stock.name: Jawbone Club
stock.desc: Exactly what it sounds like. Stamped, to everyone's surprise.

stock.name: Cloak of Iridescent Feathers
stock.desc: Shimmers green to violet. Nobody knows which bird. Daranirn won't say.

stock.name: Lamp Shaped Like a Sneezing Sea Serpent
stock.desc: Sneezes at dusk and at dawn, in that order. Daranirn calls her the Duchess and begs her pardon each time.

stock.name: Carved Bone Comb
stock.desc: Price tag in Draconic. It's a comb.

stock.name: Jar of Something That Blinks
stock.desc: Don't tap the glass. It doesn't like it.

stock.name: Lute With Teeth
stock.desc: A playable lute. The teeth are decorative, though two bards have brought it back with bandaged thumbs.

interactables.name: Exotic Wonders
pages: A jar of something that blinks. A cloak of iridescent feathers. A carved bone comb. Every price tag is in Draconic.

interactables.name: Fennick Oddlesby
pages: I only came in for a novelty egg cup. The big scaly fellow by the door has watched me the whole time. Very politely. I've never been watched so politely.
Daranirn's prices are steep, but where else can you buy a lamp shaped like a sea serpent sneezing? I didn't need one. I see that now. It's in my bag.
Forty-one years I sorted letters at the Toggleton post. I could tell you what was in a parcel by shaking it. I shook one of these and it shook back.

interactables.name: Vesper Ashgrin
pages: Welcome to Hex Topic. Band tees, piercings, cursed jewellery. Mind the amulets near the till: two of them bite and one of them just watches.
The boss is busy with brawl stuff, so I'm holding the fort. The fort is black. I repainted it on Thoughtsday, because the old black had gone grey with worry.
We've been here since the mall opened. Four owners came and went and we outlasted every one. Black never goes out of style. It waits.
She snaps her fingers and the candle on the counter gutters to a sulk. 'Mood lighting. Only cantrip I ever learned. Mum wanted me to do healing.'

1: The boss made the team! Obviously. Brawl merch is on the left: black, with a tiny lime-green gear. I fought to make the gear smaller.
4: Selunemas at Hex Topic: black tinsel, black baubles, and a black D'fain in the window. He's very mysterious. The children love him. I hate that.

stock.name: Band Tee: The Rusty Sprockets (Farewell Tour 4th)
stock.desc: Black, faded on purpose. The fourth farewell tour. Vesper went to the first three.

stock.name: Septum Ring
stock.desc: A little silver hoop. Pierced on the spot by Vesper, on any day but Meluday.

stock.name: Glow-in-the-Dark Septum Piercing
stock.desc: Novelty magic: gives off a faint moon-glow in the dark. Purely cosmetic.

stock.name: Ward of Moderate Gloom
stock.desc: A protective amulet of black glass. Counts as a holy-symbol amulet.

stock.name: Spiked Choker
stock.desc: Studded black leather. The boss wore one exactly like it to tryouts!

stock.name: Ring of Sneezing (cursed?)
stock.desc: Bargain bin. The tag says it makes you sneeze when you lie. Vesper says that's just a story. Vesper sneezed.

stock.name: Flammable Bra (On Purpose)
stock.desc: Novelty magic: once a day, a puff of harmless sparks. Warning label included.

stock.name: Totem of the Black Moth
stock.desc: A carved moth on a cord. Moths love it. So do goths.

stock.name: Black Lipstick
stock.desc: 'Night Shift' shade. Smudge-proof against tears and brawling.

interactables.name: Hex Topic Display
pages: Band tees: 'THE RUSTY SPROCKETS · FAREWELL TOUR (4th)'. A tray of septum rings. A bra with a little warning label: 'FLAMMABLE (ON PURPOSE)'.

interactables.name: Grimsby Nockle
pages: This is the only shop in Gok'Gok that gets me. My mum doesn't get me. Hex Topic gets me. The clerk keeps a darker black behind the counter just for me.
My nan bought her first cursed ring here. It made her sneeze every time she lied. She wore it to my grandad's family dinners for forty years.
Mum runs a bakery. Everything in it is pink. Even the bread. She wants me on icing. I said I'd do it in black. She said that's 'not bread'.

interactables.name: Madame Ysolde Starcrank
pages: Faestrologic: fae goods and readings. The stars say you'll buy something. The stars are on commission, and frankly, so am I.
The deck shuffles itself in her palm while she talks. 'Twelve years an actuary. Same job, really: tell folk what's likely and take payment. The incense is better here.'

0: Your horoscope: a great test approaches. You will hit something. The stars hope it's the target, but they've seen your stance.
1: Your horoscope: travel to a foreign beach. Avoid drag, or embrace it. The stars were split on this one and had to step outside to settle it.
2: Your horoscope: sand, in places you didn't know you had. Beware small students with big ideas. Moisturise.
3: Your horoscope: drama, in every sense. Two moons rise against you. Pack earplugs for the chanting and a snack for the second act.
4: Your horoscope: trees, and old faces you didn't expect. Also Selunemas shopping, which goes badly unless you buy socks. The stars are firm on socks.
5: Your horoscope: the biggest night of the year. The stars won't say where. The stars signed something and won't return my calls.
6: Your horoscope: rest. You've earned it. Leftovers, a warm sock and nobody hitting you for a week. Mine says exactly the same, for once.

stock.name: Pixie Dust
stock.desc: Imported from the fae markets at fae-market prices. Madame Ysolde's own assessment, strictly off the record: glitter.

stock.name: Humming Moonstone
stock.desc: Hums if you whisper to it.

stock.name: Wings in a Jar (decorative)
stock.desc: Empty and decorative, says the supplier. The lid is screwed on tighter than an empty jar strictly needs.

stock.name: Horoscope Reading
stock.desc: This week's stars, read aloud. Every sign has the same advice about the brawl. The stars are on commission.

stock.name: Yew Wand (druidic focus)
stock.desc: Fae-carved. Madame's mother says fae things are for taller people. It fits a gnome hand perfectly.

stock.name: Fae Charm Bracelet
stock.desc: Sometimes returns itself. Not to us.

interactables.name: Fae Goods
pages: Wings in jars (empty, decorative). Pixie dust (glitter). A moonstone that hums if you whisper to it. Everything here is very glittery.

interactables.name: Ditha Brewsnark
pages: All Kimy: potions AND poisons. Different shelves! Usually! Read the labels!
Healing on the left. Poisons on the right. Hangover cures in the middle, because that's where you'll be.
Goolax gives brawlers free healing potions every week. Ours are better. Ours taste of lemon, because I spent two winters getting the bitter out. Theirs taste of a coin.
Folk ask for the grey-plague cure. It's made right here in Toggleton, and the price depends on who's asking. I can't stock it. I can tell you which alley ones are chalk.

stock.name: Potion of Healing
stock.desc: Regain 2d4 + 2 HP. Tastes of lemon, unlike Goolax's.

stock.name: Potion of Greater Healing
stock.desc: Regain 4d4 + 4 HP. Lemon, but louder.

stock.name: Antitoxin
stock.desc: Advantage on saves against poison for 1 hour. Shelved right next to the 'DON'T' shelf, on purpose!

stock.name: Basic Poison (vial)
stock.desc: Coat a weapon or 3 pieces of ammo: 1d4 poison on a hit for 1 minute. From the 'DON'T' shelf.

stock.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
stock.desc: Throw it: 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns until put out. Not near the counter!

stock.name: Acid (vial)
stock.desc: Throw or splash: 2d6 acid damage. Gloves on, lid on, stand back, and read the label first!

stock.name: Potion of Climbing
stock.desc: Climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour. Labelled 'Probably Climbing'.

stock.name: Potion of Water Breathing
stock.desc: Breathe underwater for 1 hour. Popular before Sloopermarket week.

stock.name: Hangover Cure
stock.desc: A cloudy tonic from the middle shelf: strong tea, ginger and lemon, because Ditha puts lemon in everything she can.

6: A Goolax man asked to license my lemon. Nine years of night classes and two winters of rind, and he offered me stickers. I said no. He's coming back with more stickers.

interactables.name: Potion Shelf
pages: Bottles labelled 'Definitely Healing', 'Probably Healing', 'Ask At Counter' and 'DON'T'. The 'DON'T' shelf is nearly empty.

interactables.name: Arena Stairs
pages: You take the arena-ring stairs up to the food court.

interactables.name: Restroom
pages: RESTROOMS · Twice-filtered. A tiny sign by the sink: 'Please do not wash fish in the basins.'

interactables.name: Arena Plaque
pages: MAYOR KLERP MEMORIAL ARENA · 'He never threw a punch, but he built a place to throw them in.'

interactables.name: Goolax Banner
pages: GOOLAX PRESENTS: MALL BRAWL 2026 · 'Brawn and Brilliance!' · The referee revives the fallen. Goolax pays the bill.

1: Under the Goolax banner, someone has chalked a tally of tryout targets hit. It goes off the edge of the wall.
6: The banner's been signed by the team's fans. One signature is just a drawing of a fish.

interactables.name: Marl Turfbristle
pages: Arena groundskeeper. I sweep, I mend, I pick up teeth, and not always the competitors'. Fifteen years on a bowls green before this. Grass never bit anyone.
My nan came over from the fae side with one pot of seeds and grew a lawn on a slag heap. I've got chalk and a broom. She'd have called that cheating.

0: Targets are up for tryouts. Zippy ones on rails, heavy ones on chains, standard ones on posts. Don't touch till Seluday. I've only just got them level.
1: Tryouts done. Every target destroyed. Best week of my year. It's the only time anybody makes a mess I can be proud of.
2: Team's off to Lorfida and the arena's quiet. I've started talking to the targets. They listen better than referees.
3: I hear the Sloopermarket's arena is all sand. Sand! Imagine sweeping that. I'd give a tooth to try.
4: Selunemas lights on the arena rim this year. Orichalcum's idea. They're very bright, and they're on a timer I can't find. I've looked everywhere I'd hide one.
5: Big final coming. Nobody'll tell me where. I'll be here, sweeping, same as always. Somebody keeps the home ground ready.
6: Season's over. I found a tooth with a gold cap in the corner. I'm keeping it. Lost property can come and fight me for it.

interactables.name: Tryout Target
pages: A tryout target on a post: a painted wooden goblin holding a sign that says 'HIT ME'.

0: A fresh tryout target: a painted wooden goblin holding a sign: 'HIT ME (ON SELUDAY)'.
1: What's left of a tryout target. The sign now just says 'HI'.

interactables.name: Centre Mark
pages: A brass cog inlaid in the arena floor. Stand on it and you can hear the whole mall echo back at you. Echo... echo...

interactables.name: Tazzle Brightcog
pages: Live on Acorndr! Arena walk-and-talk! Comment your fave Cogskill brawler. No, you can't say yourself. Chat. Chat, I can see it's you.
Huge news, followers: I touched the arena wall. It's cold. Like, SO cold. Rate it. ...Two acorns. Chat's a tough room.
Nine years a junior clerk at the Toggleton Records Office, stamping births. Dad still dusts my old desk, in case. I check it's dusted when I visit.

2: Prediction stream! Will Pocket Sand throw sand? Comment 'SAND' for yes, 'ALSO SAND' for also yes.
3: Panto week! My followers want drama. I'm giving them a dramatic pause...... okay, that was too long, two people left.
5: Finale stream: WHERE IS IT? Goolax won't say! Theories in the comments! Not that one. Not that one either.
6: A hundred viewers! A HUNDRED. Ninety of them are a knitting circle who think I'm the weather. I'm doing the weather now.

brushoffs: Chat says you've already been on stream. They want someone new. Chat's ruthless.
Chat's asking who you are. I'm telling them 'nobody'. Lovingly.
Ban hammer! ...That's not real. But I'm swinging it, and you should be at least a little scared.

interactables.name: Lumi Sootfeather
pages: Have you SEEN the GaGa Gardenia ambassador's dolphin stretches? I tried one in my kitchen and took the kettle down with me. My landlady heard it and put the rent up.
Daranirn's new hire carried a crate the size of a Cryst-rail car past me and never blinked. Do lizards blink? I've been watching. I'll let you know.
Hex Topic did my nose ring when I was sixteen. It's cursed, but only on Wildsdays, when it hums whatever song I hate most. This week it's a Goolax jingle.
I sent three columns to the Gok'Gok paper. They printed one, under 'Letters', signed 'A Concerned Goblin'. I'm not concerned. I'm informed.
brushoffs: That's all I've heard. I only say what I hear, and today I've mostly heard you.
Come back when something's happened. Better yet, go and make something happen near me.
GUARDS! ...There aren't any guards. There's Nubb, and he's on pudding. Shoo anyway.

interactables.name: Brisk Tallyhop
pages: I took measurements. Professionally. For nobody. Of the Galleria Overlook's arena. The Absulinaught, they call it.
Sea spray on every surface. Wind off the strait. If we ever brawl there, bring grippy boots. That's all I'll say. Officially, nothing.
Twelve years I surveyed barley for my family's co-op. A field never once tried to knock me over. I'm told an arena might. I've packed a longer cord.

interactables.name: Trash Can
pages: An arena-ring trash can. Inside: a crumpled program, a foam finger, and a half-eaten soot-kebab.

interactables.name: Election Poster
pages: VOTE BOSCO! 'Experience You Can Count (On).' His smile has been airbrushed so hard it has a lens flare.

0: VOTE BOSCO! 'Experience You Can Count (On).' His smile has been airbrushed so hard it has a lens flare.
1: VOTE BOSCO! Someone has drawn a very small moustache on the very large moustache.
2: VOTE BOSCO! A new sticker: 'NOW WITH 20% MORE BOSCO.' A smaller one under it: 'POLLS ARE JUST VIBES.'
3: VOTE BOSCO! Half-covered by a newer sticker: 'RIGROD +12'. Somebody tried to scratch out the 1.
4: VOTE BOSCO! He's been given a paper D'fain hat. It looks better on him than the official photo does.
5: 'BOSCO LOVES SELUNEMAS (AND YOU)' — fresh print, still smells of ink. The polls, presumably, remain unmoved.
6: A Bosco poster, peeling at one corner. Underneath is an older Bosco poster. Underneath that: another Bosco.

interactables.name: Stencilled Notice
pages: Stencilled on the wall: GOOLAX OPS · SERVICE VESTIBULE · AUTHORISED KNOCKERS ONLY.

interactables.name: Gear Door
pages: A round door, all interlocking gears. You knock: three, then one, then two. Tok-tok-tok. Tok. Tok-tok.
The gears spin, clatter, and roll aside with a polite *ding*.
lockedPages: A round door made of interlocking gears. You push. You knock. Nothing. It seems to want a particular knock.

hidden.hint: Part of this wall is made of gears. It ticks.

interactables.name: Service Ladder
pages: You climb the ladder back up into the ducts.

hidden.hint: Rungs glint in a dark corner. A ladder, going up.

interactables.name: Marga Quillnettle
pages: Oh! A competitor! You found us! Marga Quillnettle, Goolax Competitor Liaison, Toggleton region. Mind the filing.
Officially, this office doesn't exist. Unofficially, it's where we keep the paperwork, the coffee, and these.
Here's a GOOLAX VIP CARD. It doesn't do anything: the pop-up booths up in unit 202 are open to every competitor. But it's laminated.
Show them the pass and they'll sell to you. Homologated gear only, of course. Goolax stamp on everything.
And please use the staff exit. If anyone asks, you were never here. Nobody ever asks. Congratulations!

interactables.name: Rankings Whiteboard
pages: A whiteboard titled MALL BRAWL 2026 · STANDINGS. Twelve team names. Every score column is blank, with 'TBD' in neat marker.

1: STANDINGS whiteboard. Tryout scores have been written in... and then wiped off. Someone wrote 'WAIT FOR LEGAL' in the corner.
3: STANDINGS whiteboard. Still mostly 'TBD'. A sticky note: 'Do NOT let competitors see this board.' Oops.
6: STANDINGS whiteboard, wiped clean. In the corner, small: 'Same time next year?'

interactables.name: Filing Cabinets
pages: Drawers labelled: WAIVERS · MORE WAIVERS · INSURANCE (HEALTH) · INSURANCE (OTHER) · HOMOLOGATION STAMPS · LOST TEETH.

interactables.name: Coffee Machine
pages: A Goolax-branded coffee machine. You press 'Espresso'. It dispenses a healing potion. You press it again: coffee. Close enough.

interactables.name: Pass Printer
pages: A brass press stamping out laminated Goolax VIP cards, one green card at a time. Ka-chunk. Ka-chunk. Ka-chunk.

interactables.name: Trophy Shelf
pages: Fifteen years of MALL BRAWL keepsakes: a dented helmet, a golden foam finger, and a jar of teeth labelled 'MEMORIES'.

interactables.name: Office Fern
pages: A plastic fern wearing a Goolax lanyard. Its name badge says 'GARY · INTERN'. Gary has been an intern for six years.

interactables.name: Desk Drawer
pages: In the desk drawer: a spare Goolax mascot head, three pens that don't work, and a note: 'Marga — stop hiding the good biscuits.'

hidden.hint: One desk drawer won't quite shut.

interactables.name: Staff Exit
pages: A narrow door marked STAFF EXIT. It lets you out into the arena concourse, behind a potted plant. Very discreet.

interactables.name: Stairs Down
pages: You head down to Level 1.

interactables.name: Pim Gearwhine
pages: Balcony seats! Best view of the stage. Second-best view of the back of a very tall hobgoblin's head.
No leaning over the rail. We lost a monocle last week. And a youngling. Found the youngling.

pages.text: From up here the projection's twice as bright and the music's twice as tinny. Like a band made of cutlery drawers.

pages: Six years an usher. Before that I was the youngling who fell asleep under seat F9 and missed the last tram. They woke me with a torch and gave me the torch.

interactables.name: Nettle Popwick
pages: Snacks! Puffed grain, salted beetles, Crystonade. The beetles crunch on the quiet bits, and I've had letters.
Rent's up, so popcorn's up a copper. Folk look at me like I bought the mall. I rent this counter. I rent the scoop.
She snaps her fingers over a pan of grain and it all pops at once. 'Machine broke in Sew. Management said they'd fix it. I told them not to bother; I'm cheaper.'

4: Selunemas special: moon-cookies! Shaped like Selune. One bite and it's Melune. I've eaten every broken one this week, for quality.

stock.name: Puffed Grain
stock.desc: Fresh this morning. This morning counts.

stock.name: Salted Beetles
stock.desc: Crunch during the loud songs.

stock.name: Crystonade
stock.desc: Glows, fizzes, is not a cryston. Legal made us say that.

stock.name: Moon-Cookie
stock.desc: One bite and it's Melune.

interactables.name: Balcony Rail
pages: You lean on the rail and look down at the stage. A stagehand is mopping. He waves. You wave. A moment.

4: Below, the Selunemas pageant rehearses. D'fain trips over Selune. Selune is a puppet. Selune forgives him.
5: Below, a full pageant crowd. A D'fain gives a heartfelt speech to a moon on a stick. Several people cry.
0: You lean on the rail. Below, a crystal projector hums, and a ghostly brass automaton plays a harp. It sounds like a cutlery drawer in love.
1: Below, projected automatons play a jig in perfect time. Nobody in the audience taps a foot. It's hard to keep up with perfect.
2: Below, the projection flickers: a brass automaton bows to applause it can't hear. A few seats away, someone claps anyway.
3: Below, real singers rehearse 'Opera for Brawlers'. One misses a high note and laughs. The stagehand cheers.

interactables.name: KL-7 "Kelly"
pages: GREETINGS, VALUED SHOPPER. I AM KL-7. PLEASE CALL ME KELLY. KELLY IS HAPPY TO HELP. KELLY HAS NO OTHER SETTING.
TODAY'S DEAL: THRICE-FILTERED AIR, ONE COPPER PER BREATH. TWICE-FILTERED AIR REMAINS FREE. KELLY RECOMMENDS FREE.
THE LIFT IS BEHIND YOU. KELLY CANNOT DISCUSS THE LIFT'S BUTTONS. KELLY HAS BEEN ASKED NOT TO.
KELLY WAS SWITCHED ON FOURTEEN MONTHS AGO IN THE STOCKROOM. KELLY'S FIRST WORD WAS 'RECEIPT'. THE MANAGER CRIED. KELLY HAS CHOSEN TO BELIEVE THEY WERE HAPPY TEARS.
brushoffs: KELLY HAS NO NEW INFORMATION. KELLY CHECKED, TO BE CERTAIN, AND IS STILL SORRY.
KELLY SUGGESTS BROWSING. AWAY FROM KELLY. THE LEFT AISLE IS LOVELY AT THIS HOUR.
KELLY IS CALLING SECURITY. KELLY IS NOT CALLING SECURITY. KELLY JUST WANTED TO SAY IT.

stock.name: Crystal (arcane focus)
stock.desc: KELLY RECOMMENDS THE BLUE ONE. KELLY RECOMMENDS ALL OF THEM.

stock.name: Crystec Headset
stock.desc: Fly over Gok'Gok Harbor! Pop-ups included at no extra cost.

stock.name: Cryston Glow-Pet
stock.desc: NEVER NEEDS FEEDING. NEEDS ATTENTION EVERY FOUR MINUTES. KELLY HAS TIMED IT.

stock.name: Cryston Night-Light
stock.desc: A soft green glow. KELLY HAS ONE. KELLY DOES NOT SLEEP.

stock.name: Thrice-Filtered Air (one breath)
stock.desc: One copper per breath. Twice-filtered air remains free.

stock.name: Signal Whistle
stock.desc: KELLY HAS BEEN ASKED NOT TO DEMONSTRATE.

interactables.name: Crystec Headset Demo
pages: You put on the demo headset. You're flying over Gok'Gok Harbor! Then a pop-up: 'BUY NOW TO KEEP FLYING.' You take it off.

interactables.name: Toggletec Lift
pages: *Ding.* The lift grumbles down to Level 1.

interactables.name: Ottra Anvilgrim
pages: Smithy Section! Repairs, sharpening, dent removal. Bring me your bent swords and your broken dreams. Dreams cost extra, and I ain't fixed one yet that held.
Homologation stamps done here too. Goolax rented me the stamp. Orichalcum raised the rent on the stamp. I keep the receipts in a drawer, and the drawer's rented and all.
Hammer's my therapy. Clang, clang. My da did forty years at the Toggleton foundry and never said a word he could hit instead. I talk more than him and hit just as hard.
My apprentice, Brannoc, went off to the Practice Range. Said he wanted somewhere quieter. He sends me a note every week, and every note's about the noise.

1: Tryout dents! So many tryout dents. I'm booked till Wildsday. Bless every one of you, and bless whoever keeps parrying with the flat of the blade.
6: End of season. Bring me what's left of your gear and I'll make it shine for next year. Brannoc's back on the bellows, too. Missed the clang, the daft lad.

interactables.name: Anvil Block
pages: A huge anvil, warm to the touch. A chalk scoreboard beside it: 'SWORDS FIXED THIS SEASON: lots.'

interactables.name: Tavish Lanyardson
pages: Goolax Pop-Up Booths! Each week after a contest, visiting vendors set up shop right here. Exclusive, curated, and lit by me personally.
Can anyone buy? Every competitor can! Just walk up. Goolax tried a pass system once. Nobody could find the desk.
Passes come from the Goolax liaison. Where's the liaison? Somewhere. Goolax loves a little treasure hunt.
Three years an intern, then one Thoughtsday they gave me a lanyard with my actual name on it. I wore it to bed. Mum's very proud. She wishes it came in blue.

0: Booths open after tryouts! Competitors, come right up. No pass, no form, no secret knock. I fought for that.
5: Five booths up, one to go. The last one opens after the final. Even I don't know who's coming, and I have three lanyards.

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 1: Dabble Sootwhistle
pages: Tryout surplus! Gear from the Cogskill mall squad, scrubbed and re-stamped. Barely dented. One boot still smells of the arena and I've grown fond of it.
Competitor? Lovely. Have a browse.
She flicks a finger and a scorch mark slides off a shield like a startled beetle. 'Cantrip. Learned it for the dishes. Brawlers are dirtier.'

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 2: Yarra Haggleby
pages: Fresh from Market, where everything's for sale and nothing's in a hurry. Stalling's leftover kit, at stalling prices.
A competitor! Good, good. Haggling's encouraged. Winning at haggling is not.
My nan taught me haggling over grain sacks. First rule: whoever names a number first has already lost. So. What were you thinking of paying?

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 3: Barnacle Bess Tidewort
pages: Ahoy! Straight from the Sloopermarket. Pocket Sand's spares, and only a little sand in the pockets. I shook them twice on the ferry over.
Show me that pass, sweetie. Then shake out your boots before you leave. Everyone does, and the cleaner still finds a beach under my table.
Thirty years I've had a stall on the Sloopermarket dock. Since the moon moved, the tide comes in when it likes. I sell by the clock now and swear at the sea.

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 4: Odo Pennyfeather
pages: From Panto by way of New Zolvina, with some Glorious Fiefdoms bits besides. A well-travelled cart, this. It's lost a wheel in each of them.
Competitors welcome, friend. Mind the chanting candles: they only hum if two of them are lit. I pack them at opposite ends of the cart on the road.
Came through the Fiefdoms in Reap. Tritone's in rebel hands, and every tavern was playing Violet Ray Sky. Sold out of candles in one night. Nobody wanted the dark.

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 5: Tamsin Burlwood
pages: Moffidge goods! Sturdy, honest, smells faintly of sawdust. A bit like me, though I did wash this morning for the trip.
Pass? Good. Everything's stamped. I checked twice. Then my mum checked, then my mum's friend checked, and then the man with the stamp got cross with us.
First time out of Moffidge. Mum packed eleven sandwiches for a two-day trip. Three left. I'm saving the cheese one for the ride home.

interactables.name: Pop-Up Booth 6: Hesper Vane
pages: Where have I come from? Oh, here and there. The end of the season. I've brought souvenirs from a very big night. You'll have heard about it, or you will.
Show me your pass, and don't ask too many questions. Selunemas is a time for mystery, and I like my trade seasonal.
She turns a brass token over her knuckles, and it's gone. 'Everyone asks how. Nobody asks where it went. Isn't that the better question?'

interactables.name: Unit 202 Sign
pages: UNIT 202 · GOOLAX POP-UP BOOTHS · Visiting vendors weekly · ALL COMPETITORS WELCOME

interactables.name: Entrance Balcony
pages: From the balcony you can see the whole entrance rotunda below: the info kiosk, the brass star, people coming in from the Cryst-rail.

0: Below, a crowd queues for tryout sign-up. A youngling at the front is holding a frying pan, hopefully.
4: Below, someone is stringing Selunemas lights over the doors. A D'fain on a ladder. Security is very worried.
6: Below, a little crowd has gathered just to clap people in through the doors. Cogskill's proud of its own.

interactables.name: Primula Hatchworth
pages: Homewares, upstairs at Dullard's! Kettles downstairs, cups up here. Yes, it's annoying. It sells more cups.
The good socks are on the end. Cog-patterned, double heel. I own forty pairs and I'm wearing two of them.
She taps a chipped saucer and the chip creeps back into place. 'Mending. Dullard's doesn't know. Our breakage figures are the best in Toggleton and nobody can work out why.'

interactables.name: Dullard's Stairs
pages: You head down Dullard's stairs to Level 1.

interactables.name: Hidebert Strapknot
pages: Let Her! Leather. Jackets, boots, armour that creaks attractively. Let her! Let him! Let anyone! We don't ask, we just measure.
Studded or unstudded? Trick question. Everything is studded. We had a plain belt in Sew. A customer brought it back and asked what was wrong with it.
Seven years at the Toggleton tanneries before this. Lost my sense of smell in the second year. Best thing that ever happened to a leather man.

4: Selunemas sale: leather D'fain coats, warm as a hug and red as a cheek. Our D'fain upstairs wears one. Listen for him. He creaks when he ho's.
6: I sold an unstudded belt today. Plain leather, one buckle, and a customer who wanted exactly that. I had to go and sit in the stockroom for a bit.

stock.name: Leather Armor
stock.desc: AC 11 + Dex. Creaks attractively. Stamped.

stock.name: Studded Leather Armor
stock.desc: AC 12 + Dex. We have a stud problem. Stamped.

stock.name: Hide Armor
stock.desc: AC 12 + Dex (max 2). Smells of the smithy. Stamped.

stock.name: 'Brawl Lime' Leather Jacket
stock.desc: COGSKILL on the back, slightly wonky! Hidebert calls the wonk hand-finishing, and he means it.

stock.name: Leather Boots
stock.desc: Creak test included.

stock.name: Leather D'fain Coat
stock.desc: Warm, creaky and as red as D'fain's own. Forty-one studs on the cuffs, which Hidebert calls restraint.

interactables.name: Jacket Rack
pages: Leather jackets in black, oxblood and 'Brawl Lime'. One has COGSKILL embroidered on the back, slightly wonky.

interactables.name: Fizz Ratchetkin
pages: Cryst-o-Games, home of the high score. Tokens at the counter. Don't hit GEARFALL, it's sensitive. It's older than me and it's had a harder life.
Psst. I went to Galleria Overlook with my cousin. Took photos for 'research'. All blurry. Look: purple blur. Mushroom blur. My cousin, blurry and cross.
Their food court's up near the cap of the mushroom. Sea views! And fae just flying round your noodles like that's normal. Gross. Cool. I'd go back.
That gnome kid's here every day after school. I keep a token in my apron for when he's skint and slip it in the slot. He thinks the machine likes him. Let him.

interactables.name: GEARFALL Cabinet
pages: GEARFALL's high-score table flickers and jumps. You focus. The top three initials, read down: L-F-T... W-C-?... 2-N-D?
No. Read across the scores: LFT · BTN · W.C. 'Lift. Button. W.C.' The machine hiccups, then the table shows normal names again.
lockedPages: GEARFALL: stack the falling gears before the boiler blows! The high-score table glitches a bit. Old machine.

interactables.name: TOGGLE TUMBLE Cabinet
pages: TOGGLE TUMBLE: roll a gnome down a factory chute. You play badly. 'GAME OVER. TIP: TRY CRYSTON CRUSH NEXT. ;)'

interactables.name: CRYSTON CRUSH Cabinet
pages: You enter the cheat from Toggle Tumble's winky face. The screen goes black... SECRET LEVEL 0: BOSCO'S BIG BAILOUT.
You play a tiny Bosco dodging falling poll numbers. It's unwinnable. The high-score table is just 'RIGROD' 50 times.
lockedPages: CRYSTON CRUSH: match three crystons! You match three crystons. It is very satisfying. That's the whole game.

interactables.name: CRANKY KART Cabinet
pages: CRANKY KART: race steam-karts round Gok'Gok Harbor. The Cryst-rail shortcut is a trap. You took the Cryst-rail shortcut.

interactables.name: MALL BRAWL: THE GAME
pages: MALL BRAWL: THE GAME (unofficial). Pick your mall! Cogskill's fighter is a gnome with a wrench. Special move: 'Rent Hike'.

2: MALL BRAWL: THE GAME. Someone added a new fighter by hand-painting a Lorfida sticker on the screen.
3: MALL BRAWL: THE GAME. The 'Pocket Sand' character's special move is just throwing sand at the screen. Accurate.
6: MALL BRAWL: THE GAME. 'SEASON COMPLETE. INSERT COIN FOR 2027.'

interactables.name: Bix Tinderbolt
pages: I've played GEARFALL nine hundred times. The high scores go all wiggly sometimes. Like it's trying to TELL you something.
Fizz behind the counter says there's a secret level in Cryston Crush. You need a cheat. The cheat's in another game.
Mum does late shifts at the plant so I come here. Fizz says I'm the manager now. I'm not. But I know where all the sticky bits are, so I could be.

interactables.name: Prize Counter
pages: Prizes: a rubber fish (100 tickets), a Bosco yo-yo (5 tickets, still not moving), a Goolax plushie (1,000 tickets).

interactables.name: Mirabel Doilyfeather
pages: I sold doilies here back when it was Spangle's, forty-one years on this carpet. Now it's GaGa Gardenia and they kept me on at the till. Leggings are softer than doilies.
The yoga class is always heated, love. The fire elementals take the front row, and nobody argues with the front row. I stand at the back by the door, in my cardigan.
That snow globe? Spangle's left it behind when they moved out. I keep it here for luck. Lord knows where it had been before that, and I've never liked to ask.
My sister's lot farm barley outside Quone, rebel side, like most of us halflings. She writes every month. I won't call it a squabble, love. They're burying people.

4: Selunemas sale! Thermal leggings in Goolax green and D'fain red. I bought three pairs and I don't do yoga. Two are going to my sister. Nights are cold in Quone.

stock.name: Goolax Standard Fighting Wraps
stock.desc: Plain match-legal hand wraps for unarmed fighters. Breathable!

stock.name: Fighting Wraps, Grade I (+1)
stock.desc: +1 to unarmed strike attack and damage rolls. GaGa Gardenia's own line.

stock.name: Fighting Wraps, Grade II (+1, Flurry)
stock.desc: +1 to unarmed strikes; once per match, one extra unarmed strike as part of your Attack action.

stock.name: Heated Yoga Leggings
stock.desc: Softer than the doilies Mirabel sold at Spangle's for thirty years, love, and she would know.

stock.name: Grip Socks
stock.desc: For dolphin stretches. And for not sliding off a Bulwark.

stock.name: Studio Class Pass
stock.desc: One heated dolphin-stretch class. Front row is taken. It's always taken.

stock.name: Waterskin (GaGa Green)
stock.desc: Stay hydrated. Stayyyy greasy.

stock.name: Thermal Leggings (Goolax Green & D'fain Red)
stock.desc: Selunemas sale. Mirabel bought three pairs: one for her, two posted to her sister on the farm in Quone.

interactables.name: Snow Globe
pages: A snow globe: a giant purple mushroom on a rock spire, waves at its foot. 'GREETINGS FROM GALLERIA OVERLOOK, BANAÑON TOWN'.
Shake it and tiny glittering fae swirl round the cap instead of snow. A price sticker: 'NOT FOR SALE (EVIDENCE)'.

interactables.name: Tiny Door
pages: Down at the bottom of the wall: a perfect little door, six inches tall, with a brass knocker the size of a bean.
A sign beside it, in very small writing: 'SMALLFOLK ONLY. NO, SMALLER.' You hear tiny snoring.

hidden.hint: You hear tiny snoring from the skirting board.

interactables.name: Election Poster
pages: EXCELSIOR RIGROD · 'Clean Crystons. Clean Council.' A tidy gnome in a tidy suit holding a very tidy cryston.

0: EXCELSIOR RIGROD · 'Clean Crystons. Clean Council.' A tidy gnome in a tidy suit holding a very tidy cryston.
1: EXCELSIOR RIGROD · 'Clean Crystons. Clean Council.' Someone added 'Clean Socks?' in pencil. He'd probably approve.
2: RIGROD · 'Corruption is a cryston leak. I am the patch.' A volunteer has stapled a little pamphlet holder on.
3: RIGROD LEADS IN LATEST POLL, says a sticker. An even newer sticker says 'POLLS ARE JUST VIBES.' A war of stickers.
4: RIGROD · Selunemas edition: he's holding a cryston wrapped in a bow. Even his festive spirit looks audited.
5: RIGROD · 'Give Toggleton a Selunemas present: a fair count.' Someone has drawn a heart next to it.
6: RIGROD · the poster's been laminated. His team clearly expects to be here for a while.

interactables.name: Election Poster
pages: VOTE BOSCO! 'Experience You Can Count (On).' His smile has been airbrushed so hard it has a lens flare.

0: VOTE BOSCO! 'Experience You Can Count (On).' His smile has been airbrushed so hard it has a lens flare.
1: VOTE BOSCO! Someone has drawn a very small moustache on the very large moustache.
2: VOTE BOSCO! A new sticker: 'NOW WITH 20% MORE BOSCO.' A smaller one under it: 'POLLS ARE JUST VIBES.'
3: VOTE BOSCO! Half-covered by a newer sticker: 'RIGROD +12'. Somebody tried to scratch out the 1.
4: VOTE BOSCO! He's been given a paper D'fain hat. It looks better on him than the official photo does.
5: 'BOSCO LOVES SELUNEMAS (AND YOU)' — fresh print, still smells of ink. The polls, presumably, remain unmoved.
6: A Bosco poster, peeling at one corner. Underneath is an older Bosco poster. Underneath that: another Bosco.

interactables.name: Old Spanner Quill
pages: I helped build this mall, you know. Bolted half these walls. They've changed owners four times. Walls haven't changed once.
These new owners raised the rent till my daughter's shop, Spangle's, had to move out. I'm on this bench in protest. Also my knees.
My girl's got a stall out on the harbour road now. Doing fine, she says. She says it the way I used to say me back was fine.

interactables.name: Wobbet Frothmire
pages: Clara's Brews! Ales, stouts, and Clara's famous Foundry Fizz. No, I'm not Clara. Nobody's ever met Clara. My wages come in an envelope that smells of hops.
Brawlers drink half price. Goolax pays the other half. Goolax doesn't know that yet.
He breathes on an empty glass and frost crawls up it. 'Fifteen years on a Ban'ton brew-barge. Ice cost money out there, so you learned.'

4: Selunemas Spiced Stout is on tap! Tastes like cinnamon and a bit of regret, the nice kind, from the year you kissed somebody at a party.
6: Season's over! Raise a glass to the team. Raise two. I'm counting, mind, and you pay at the end. Oh, and I got the foam right. Left Clara a note.

brushoffs: That's all the tap's got today. Come back after the Thoughtsday delivery.
You're leaning on my bar like it owes you money.
Last orders! For you, specifically. Off you go.

stock.name: Foundry Fizz
stock.desc: A stout that thinks it's a soda.

stock.name: Pint of Ale
stock.desc: Brawlers half price. Goolax pays the other half.

stock.name: Water
stock.desc: From the tap, frosted by Wobbet's breath. Clara's note says water is free. The glass costs a copper.

stock.name: Selunemas Spiced Stout
stock.desc: Like a hug from a barrel. The recipe arrived in the wage envelope, signed 'C.'

stock.name: Pretzel
stock.desc: Salted, large, and twisted by hand at four in the morning by someone Wobbet has never once seen.

interactables.name: Slurpa Gloopwhistle
pages: Goo to Go! Slurpy food for busy folk. Today: Grey Goo, Greener Goo, and Goo Surprise. The surprise is texture.
My gran sold Grey Goo off a cart on the harbour flats. Same recipe. Same cart, under the counter; I just can't lift it. She'd have liked this queue.
Snail folk love us. Everyone else tolerates us. We're the fastest food on this level and I'm the slowest thing on it. Some days the goo gets to you before my hello does.

stock.name: Grey Goo
stock.desc: Gran's recipe, sold off a cart on the harbour flats. The cart is under the counter. It's too heavy to move.

stock.name: Greener Goo
stock.desc: Our classic, but greener.

stock.name: Goo Surprise
stock.desc: The surprise is texture.

stock.name: Straw
stock.desc: The spoons went missing in Sew. Slurpa is... still waiting... for one to come back.

interactables.name: Tillo Plantainsworth
pages: Oh Banañons! Banañon dishes, Ban'ton style. Fried banañon, banañon bread, banañon with banañon sauce. Gran's recipes, and her bread still rises higher than mine.
My cousins live in Banañon Town. I visited. For family. Definitely not to peek at Galleria Overlook. ...Okay, I peeked. For most of an afternoon.
That mall's a huge purple mushroom on a stone spire over the sea. Stairs spiral up the stem. Pixies in the rafters. Show-offs.
My uncle's lot came down from Quone when the fighting started. Folk here call it the Squat Squabble. He doesn't call it anything. He just peels banañons with me.

stock.name: Fried Banañon
stock.desc: Ban'ton style, the way Tillo's uncle makes them on the days he gets up off the sofa.

stock.name: Banañon Bread
stock.desc: Gran's recipe. It doesn't rise like gran's yet, but we're getting there, we think, we hope.

stock.name: Banañon with Banañon Sauce
stock.desc: Banañon squared.

stock.name: Banañon Smoothie
stock.desc: Yellow enough to read by. Tillo drinks two before opening and is not allowed a third.

interactables.name: Grisla Chopsworth
pages: CARNA. Meat on a stick, off a stick, in a bun. We don't do vegetables. We tolerate gravy, and only because the children cry without it.
Brawler Special: the Big Bonk. Two patties, three kinds of cheese, one nap afterwards. Nobody's finished one standing up. A troll came close in Sew.
Twenty-two years I cooked on the Gok'Gok ferries. Swell comes, you hold the pan, not the rail. Here the floor stays still and I still hold the pan.

4: Selunemas roast. Every bird, stuffed in a bigger bird, stuffed in the biggest bird I could get. Goolax wanted a sticker on the outside one. No room.
6: End of season. I'm letting the grill go out on Selunemas night. First time since the mall opened. I'll sit with it till it's cold.

stock.name: Big Bonk
stock.desc: Two patties, three cheeses, one nap.

stock.name: Meat on a Stick
stock.desc: Or off a stick.

stock.name: Gravy Cup
stock.desc: Made from the grill's drippings. The grill has not been off since the mall opened.

stock.name: Selunemas Bird-in-a-Bird
stock.desc: Grisla knows how many birds. The grill knows. You get the outside one.

interactables.name: Plosh Ithren
pages: Whet! Flotian cuisine, from the sea to your seat. Raw, cured, or 'just looked at'. Order the third only with a strong stomach and a free afternoon.
In Flot we say the family name first, as the tide comes before the boat. I'm Ithren of the Plosh family. Plosh Ithren. Eat the kelp.
She breathes across the counter, and a thin frost spreads over the ice. 'In Flot the sea keeps the fish cold. In Gok'Gok, I do it. Every hour, on the hour.'

stock.name: Kelp Bowl
stock.desc: The kelp will know if you don't eat it.

stock.name: Cured Strait Fish
stock.desc: Cured the Flot way, by the tide. The tide no longer keeps hours, so this batch took eleven days instead of six.

stock.name: 'Just Looked At' Platter
stock.desc: Raw fish that has been, Plosh assures you, looked at by an expert.

stock.name: Sea-Salt Crackers
stock.desc: Salt from Plosh's grandmother's pans in Flot. This is the last sack of it.

interactables.name: Moss Burrowby
